result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly around content being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation and low text contrast in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card is cut off behind the bottom nav, making the page look clipped and potentially hiding tappable content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white text on a very light mint background, resulting in low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text, darken the banner background, or add stronger contrast behind the text to meet accessibility contrast guidelines.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are partially cut off at the right edge, such as the category chip after 'Healthy' and the third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you'. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it can look visually unfinished without clearer spacing or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel clipping is intentional and polished by adding consistent side padding, showing a cleaner partial-card preview, or using a subtle scroll indicator.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons sit on dark image areas with a dark translucent circular background, which reduces visual separation in some cards.
issues.suggestion: Increase the opacity contrast of the button background or use a lighter scrim so the favorite action remains clearly visible on all images.
